content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Denver

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Verify your background meets one of these pathways before enrolling. Granite PM Academy's team can review your qualifications to ensure you're ready to apply.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Our synchronous online course delivers the full PMI-mandated contact hours on a schedule that fits working professionals across Denver's aerospace, energy, healthcare, and financial-services sectors. You'll learn directly from active certified practitioners.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, submit your PMP application to PMI with proof of your 35 contact hours from Granite PM Academy. Pay the PMI examination fee and allow time for PMI to review and approve your credentials before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—including practice tests, study guides, and Q&A support—to solidify your readiness. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts as you finalize your preparation.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or additional certifications. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to help you stay current and competitive in your role.
